title: git over HTTPS with the token as a header; .git/config is left unchanged
steps: bash -c "a=$(git config --local --list | md5sum); python scripts/githost.py git ls-remote origin HEAD; b=$(git config --local --list | md5sum); [ \"$a\" = \"$b\" ] && echo config-unchanged"
